premises.text: Typical search stacks force changes in three places—database, index, and web server—when modifying the index
premises.evidence_span: every time we wanted to modify the index, we had to change the system in three separate places

premises.text: ThriftDB combines database, search index, and web server into one database-with-search system
premises.evidence_span: ThriftDB is just combining the database, the search index, and the web server into one system

premises.text: Companies model data as objects with attributes; ThriftDB handles objects natively for put/get/search
premises.evidence_span: we designed ThriftDB to handle objects natively. With ThriftDB, you put in objects, you get objects back, you search across them

premises.text: Delivers fast scalable search with attribute filters, facets, and flexible schema uploads out of the box
